items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All 4 ACs: runner uses uv run --no-project --python >=3.11, due route returns pinned contract per project and all projects, done/snooze/add call the CLI only with refusal passthrough, pinned-shape + per-state tests.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every CLI/contract failure is a named state (engine-unavailable, unreadable, unsupported-version, store-busy, failed, degraded); thrown runner errors map to 502.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No shell, flag=value argv and -- before positionals, JSON content-type required (415), id/day/url-scheme/NUL/size validation, local paths dropped, no writer for reminders.jsonl.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 55 unit tests plus a real-CLI round trip incl. leading-dash values and secret refusal.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: All-projects read bounded to 3 concurrent children, 30s timeout, tree-kill via shared helper; no cache yet (noted for W3).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New files all under 300 lines; index.ts mount is 3 lines, stays at its 958 baseline.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer reminder_cli.py due --json to consumer reminder-contract.ts; round-tripped for real in the integration test and pinned against reminder_due.py field lists.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --files on the 4 new test files: no findings.
